source.title: Planning conference travel
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: The department will make arrangements for students to attend a regional conference. Each applicant must provide evidence of how the event relates to their research. Because the travel fund is limited, the panel will compare the purpose and expected benefit of each visit. Students should describe a specific session they plan to attend rather than simply listing the speakers they admire.
